subject: ClearPort weekly security checkpoint — evidence & pen test window
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearport.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearport.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: security evidence & pen test window for SOC 2/DPA checklist

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're trying to lock the MAP items for SOC 2 + DPA for our procurement review. Two quick asks so we can close on the internal security checklist:

1) Can you confirm the pen test window availability (we're aiming for a Sept 13-17 window)?
2) We need a short set of audit log samples and a retention statement for the platform (90 / 365 days is what our auditors are asking).

I've attached the latest questionnaire (ClearPort_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf) — we've highlighted a couple of fields that need explicit docs or artifacts. If you can point to owners and expected delivery dates for each highlighted item that will speed sign-off.

Proposed next steps: brief sync tomorrow or Wednesday; if you prefer a written owner list that also works.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Security, ClearPort
liam.oneill@clearport.com

Attachments: ClearPort_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearport.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: security evidence & pen test window for SOC 2/DPA checklist

Liam —

Thanks for the clear asks and for the questionnaire. We're aligned to move quickly. High level:

- Pen test window: we can accommodate Sept 13-17. Priyom will be the internal lead coordinating scope and the external engagement. We'll publish an access matrix and test targets by EOD Friday (8/27).
- Audit logs & retention: we retain request/response + admin audit trails for 365 days by default; we can provide a 90-day export subset as a sample artifact.

I've attached the proposed calendar invite (proposed-pen-test-window.ics) and tagged the owners below.

Owners / commitment (initial):
- Priyom Das: pen test coordination, scope doc, access matrix — delivery 2027-08-27
- Grace Oconnor: audit log export + retention statement and sample — delivery 2027-08-30
- Jordan Blake: contract redline owner (DPA clause) — delivery 2027-08-31

If that timeline works for ClearPort we'll slot the pen test and return the highlighted questionnaire entries inline.

Marissa
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: proposed-pen-test-window.ics

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearport.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: evidence & pen test sprint — owner commit

Team — quick internal status update after today's stand and to confirm action items for ClearPort MAP checkpoint. I'm keeping Liam looped for visibility.

Status summary:
- Scope draft: 70% complete (will include list of endpoints, infra components, and auth flows).
- Network diagram: collecting final redactions from infra (ETA 8/27).
- Audit log export: sample prepared — pending redaction and packaging.

Action items (owners + delivery):
- Priyom Das: finalize test scope doc and access matrix — DUE 2027-08-27 (deliverable: scope.md, access-matrix.csv)
- Grace Oconnor: generate 90-day audit log export, redact PII, and produce retention statement — DUE 2027-08-30 (deliverable: redacted-audit-log-sample.zip, retention-statement.pdf)
- Jordan Blake: DPA clause proposed language and quick redline — DUE 2027-08-31 (deliverable: DPA_redline.docx)
- Marissa Cole: customer-facing summary + questionnaire inline responses — DUE 2027-08-30 (deliverable: completed_questionnaire.pdf)

Blockers / notes:
- External pen test vendor requires a CVE baseline; we'll need to confirm which images are in scope. Priyom to call the infra lead by EOD.
- Grace flagged that the export will contain low-risk tokens that must be redacted; timeline reflects extra QA for redaction.

I will update the HubSpot MAP (link below) after we post deliverables.

PRIYOM

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CP-78421
From: Elena Morales <elena@clearport.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearport.com>, security@clearport.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: security evidence & pen test window for SOC 2/DPA checklist

Marissa / team —

Appreciate the rapid response and the owner list. A couple of quick clarifications from our audit team before we mark the MAP item as closed:

- Can you provide the retention-statement.pdf language in a one-paragraph summary we can put in the procurement dossier?
- For the audit log export: please include timestamps in UTC and an example row with request-id, user-id (pseudonymized), resource, action, and outcome. If you can add that as a CSV row in the package it would be ideal.

We'll hold the pen test scheduling until we get the scope doc + sample log export. Once we receive the artifacts we'll confirm the Sept 13-17 window.

For tracking I've uploaded a minimal evidence manifest on our side and attached the pointer.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Security Analyst, ClearPort
elena@clearport.com

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv
